FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 223
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/03/2026
Senate Bill 223 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Office of Attorney General,
by an undetermined amount, to bring a civil action against parties that use Automatic Dependent
Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) data to assess fees or charges against aircraft owners or
operators. This increased obligation could be offset in whole or in part, by the recovery of civil
penalties, up to $10,000 per violation, and reasonable attorney fees awarded by the court per the
provisions of this bill.
